title: Beyond WER: Probing Whisper’s Sub-token Decoder Across Diverse Language Resource Levels

bias_targets.methodology: Tracing the beam search decoding path of the Whisper ASR model to analyze sub-token generation across 20 languages. The study calculates metrics such as the average rank of the correct sub-token, model confidence, predictive entropy, and alternate-candidate diversity, and compares these across high, medium, and low-resource language tiers to measure disparities.
